# Digitized data from Morris et al. (201: # "Contributions of organic and inorganic matter to sediment volume and
#  accretion in tidal wetlands at steady state"
# Data from 2008 field measurements; figure also reproduced in Miller et al. (2019)
# Remote Sensing with the parabolic fit B = 14.8*E - 0.157*E^2 + 598.
# Figure shows aboveground biomass (dry g m-2) vs pipe elevation (cm NAVD88).
# Values digitized by eye from the published figure; positional uncertainty is
# approximately +/-2 cm in elevation and +/-30 g m-2 in biomass.
# biomass_se_g_m2 is the half-height of the plotted error bar (estimated standard error).
# Fitted curves (from Miller et al. 2019 figure):
#   plum_island  (PI): slope = -5.3 g m-2 cm-1;                 r2=0.85
#   biomass_g_m2         : mean aboveground biomass (dry g m-2)
#   biomass_se_g_m2      : estimated standard error (half error-bar height)
# NI data cover both the ascending limb (-35 to ~73 cm) and the descending
# right limb (~80 to ~110 cm); the parabola zero is near 125 cm NAVD88.
# NI MHW ~70 cm; PI MHW ~120 cm.
